rules: R1 err.refusal with a string `why` and `by` in {core, binding, keyholder}: by = refusal.by, why = refusal.why verbatim, op = refusal.op if a string, else the caller's op.
R2 otherwise why = err.message with a leading "<method>: " stripped when present.
R3 why starts "no such method: " -> by keyholder, why = "The producer does not serve <method> yet."
R4 why matches /refused this origin|keyholder origin is required|did not load|did not answer|failed to load|loaded without connect/ -> by transport, why verbatim.
R5 otherwise -> by keyholder, why verbatim.
NEVER by 'core' without R1. NEVER 'site' from any producer answer: 'site' is consumer-only, for refusals made before asking.
